name: peartube-monorepo
description: PearTube monorepo - P2P video streaming for desktop and mobile

scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:ebuild --prefix packages/app
scripts.desktop:stage: node -e "throw new Error('Pear OTA staging is not wired for the Electrobun desktop app yet.')"
scripts.desktop:release: node -e "throw new Error('Pear OTA release is not wired for the Electrobun desktop app yet.')"
scripts.schema: cd packages/spec && rm -rf spec/hrpc spec/schema && node schema.cjs
scripts.prepare:mobile-backend: npm run schema && npm run bundle:backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix packages/spec && npm test --prefix packages/backend && npm test --prefix packages/host
scripts.lint:complexity: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json packages/backend/src packages/cli/src packages/cli/bin.js packages/app/app packages/app/components packages/app/lib packages/app/backend packages/host/src packages/platform/src scripts packages/spec/schema.cjs --max-warnings 369
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix packages/spec && npm install --prefix packages/backend && npm install --prefix packages/cli && npm install --prefix packages/host && npm install --prefix packages/platform && npm install --prefix packages/app --legacy-peer-deps
